name: hamloy
description: Coordinate your coding agents. Don't orchestrate them. Claude Code, Codex and Cursor keep working their way. Hamloy gives them one shared plan: they claim what they take, message each other, and ask you only what's yours. You see all of it on one page: what every agent is on, what it finished, and what waits on you, for your own agents and your collaborators' alike.
